text:
sarah_sales: quick check — a fintech prospect (mid-market) asked if we can fast-track a 6-week POC on Dedicated with a one-time 50% discount on commit for the trial period. they want legacy pricing applied to any overages during the POC window. can we do this without exec signoff?

raj_dealdesk: 50% one-time on commit + legacy overage carry sounds like a special-term. need deal desk approval. do we have expected MRR/ARR or logo size? :thinking_face:

sarah_sales: they estimated ~$18k/mo during POC, potential to commit 3-6 months after with ~150k ARR. asks are time-boxed to the POC months only.

elliot_se: from a technical side, Dedicated capacity profile looks ok. main risk is burst overage if their regression tests generate spikes. we'd want a soft cap + alerting.

linda_finance: finance: a 50% discount on commit is material. need to know whether this is a promo (one-off credit) or changes the effective SKU price for the customer's account. billing prefers a one-time credit so bookkeeping is simpler.

raj_dealdesk: propose pathway: 1) create a Special Terms request 2) tag as "fast-track" for 48h review window 3) require AM + finance ack 4) if >40% discount escalate to VP Sales.

sarah_sales: ok — can you draft the Special Terms text? customer needs reply by EOD.

raj_dealdesk: draft below — please review:```Special Terms Request — Fast-Track POC
Customer: [REDACTED]
POC window: 6 weeks starting on signed SOW
Discount: one-time 50% credit applied to committed capacity invoice covering the POC window only
Overages: billed at legacy per-token rate for POC window (no automatic price reduction beyond POC)
Conditions: customer must sign SOW and provide purchase order; AM to confirm expected load and run smoke test during week 1; finance to approve one-time credit before activation
Expiration: auto-reverts to standard ratecard after POC end
```

elliot_se: looks good. add a note about throttling/alerting: "we reserve the right to throttle sustained spikes that exceed agreed test profile" — avoids runaway compute.

linda_finance: finance ack pending the one-time credit accounting treatment. if it's structured as a credit, we need cost center and GL mapping before we apply.

raj_dealdesk: creating request in DealDesk tool now — REF-REQ-8652. dealbot: posted the ticket.

dealbot: New Special Terms ticket created REF-REQ-8652 by raj_dealdesk. Reviewers: linda_finance, vp_sales, sarah_sales. Status: awaiting finance ack.

sarah_sales: thanks. timeline: I told customer we'd respond within 24h. can finance do ack by EOD?

linda_finance: pushing for EOD. if we need faster, I can pre-approve pending GL mapping as long as AM confirms PO.

raj_dealdesk: if finance pre-approves, i'll sign off and VP escalation only if final discount >50% or commit length >12 months.

sarah_sales: final Q — do we need any redlining on the SOW for "legacy overage" term? legal copy ok with our usual phrase?

elliot_se: legal should keep it explicit: "overage pricing for POC period equals legacy rate X; any sustained overages beyond test profile subject to throttling and review."

raj_dealdesk: noted. will attach legal-approved clause from template.

dealbot: REF-REQ-8652 updated: finance_ack pending, vp_sales not required. ETA: 18h.

sarah_sales: appreciated. i'll tell them we have a request in motion and expect approval within a business day. :thumbsup:
